span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Gamma-frequency synchronization between vHPC and mPFC carries the spatial cue across the direct projection, so that entrainment of mPFC spikes to vHPC gamma is what enables successful encoding.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: vHPC gamma oscillations entrain vHPC output in phase, which then influences mPFC spike timing at monosynaptic delays, making spike entrainment the physical signature of the signal being propagated.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The vHPC input acts excitatorily on mPFC units, driving the location-selective elevation of firing rate that constitutes the cue representation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: vHPC input drives a selective firing-rate elevation in each unit's preferred goal, without changing baseline rates
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the same goal selectivity persists during choice runs and no longer needs vHPC input, so physiology mirrors the behavioural dissociation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: vHPC gamma leads mPFC spiking at lags consistent with monosynaptic transmission, and terminal inhibition reduces that phase-locking
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the directionality is specific to gamma: in theta the mPFC leads, and theta synchrony survives terminal inhibition
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: terminal illumination suppresses transmission without silencing the source cells, which is what makes the manipulation projection-specific
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a four-goal maze prevents the animal from forming a spatially directed plan until the choice phase, which is what separates encoding from retrieval
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The authors cannot definitively exclude an effect of terminal inhibition during the choice (retrieval) phase; the null result there was underpowered.
span.note: what this limits: the encoding claim as against the choice phase: ALTHOUGH WE CANNOT CONCLUSIVELY RULE OUT AN EFFECT OF TERMINAL INHIBITION DURING CHOICE, THESE EXPERIMENTS INDICATE THAT INPUT FROM THE vHPC TO THE mPFC IS CRITICAL FOR ENCODING
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Retrospective location coding might exist in mPFC in a form their decoding analysis could not detect (e.g. synaptic weights or very brief reactivation).
span.note: what this limits: the absence of retrospective coding, which is scoped to the ANALYSIS: IT IS NOT DETECTABLE USING THE ANALYTIC TECHNIQUES PRESENTED HERE, SUCH AS in synaptic weights or in reactivation too brief for the bins
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The pseudo-population decoding approach assumes comparable spike statistics across animals and sessions and discards correlated variability.
span.note: what this limits: every population-decoding result: THIS APPROACH ASSUMES EQUIVALENT SPIKE STATISTICS ACROSS ANIMALS AND RECORDING SESSIONS, AND IGNORES POTENTIAL CONTRIBUTIONS TO POPULATION CODING FROM CORRELATED SPIKE VARIABILITY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The gamma phase-locking effect is small: under 10% of mPFC units were significantly phase-locked even at the best lag.
span.note: what this limits: the gamma phase-locking claim, with its size: AT THE LAG WITH THE GREATEST PHASE-LOCKING, FEWER THAN 10% OF mPFC UNITS WERE SIGNIFICANTLY PHASE-LOCKED TO vHPC GAMMA
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the choice-phase null is not conclusive; an n of 37 per group would have been needed to detect the observed effect size
span.note: what this limits: the choice-phase null, with what it would have taken to see the effect: A SLIGHT TREND TOWARD IMPAIRMENT DID NOT REACH SIGNIFICANCE, AND POST-HOC POWER ANALYSIS REVEALED THAT AN n OF 37 PER GROUP would have been required
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the authors state plainly that they cannot conclusively rule out an effect during choice
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[0] · what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - an effect during choice is not conclusively excluded
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the absence of retrospective coding is scoped to the analysis: it could be held in synaptic weights or in reactivation too brief to decode from binned histograms
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 1 - the null on retrospective coding is a null of the method
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the gamma effect is subtle - fewer than 10% of mPFC units were significantly phase-locked at the best lag

span.label: RETRACTED (RE-GROUNDED) · vHPC —causes→ mPFC
span.note: RETRACTED: RE-GROUNDED. The old span named neither endpoint. This sentence names both and states the anatomy the edge rests on - a UNIDIRECTIONAL projection, which is what makes the arrow's direction defensible. — strength of the relation: 0.95 — SCOPE: critical for encoding, but explicitly NOT for maintenance or retrieval. the same edge is false if the phase is changed - one of the sharpest scope cases in the corpus
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: encoding —contrasted-with→ retrieval
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHICH PHASE OF THE MEMORY THE PATHWAY IS NEEDED FOR, AND THREE PHASES ARE NAMED. 'Quotation withheld.' The same anatomy is necessary at one moment of a trial and dispensable at the others - so a lesion or inactivation that spans the whole trial cannot produce this result, and studies that do span it will report the pathway as generally required. Q-484. · strength of the relation: 1
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: gamma —contrasted-with→ theta
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS FREQUENCY BAND, AND THE DIRECTION OF FLOW REVERSES WITH IT. 'Quotation withheld.' The same two structures lead each other in opposite directions depending on the band - so a connectivity claim without the band is not merely imprecise, it is ambiguous between two opposite claims. Q-487. · strength of the relation: 1 — opposite directionality between the same two structures, and only gamma depends on the direct pathway
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Optogenetically silencing vHPC-to-mPFC terminals during the sample run impairs delayed non-match-to-place performance in opsin-expressing mice, while the same silencing during the entire trial also impairs it and silencing during choice does not reach significance.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In a redesigned 4-goal maze that separates encoding from retrieval, sample-phase silencing again impaired performance, confirming the pathway is required specifically for encoding.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Silencing the pathway during the memory delay produced no significant behavioural impairment.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Population decoding of the sample goal from mPFC units was abolished (reduced to chance) by terminal illumination in Arch-expressing mice but was unchanged in Arch-negative controls.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Sample-phase terminal inhibition removed the firing-rate increase that goal-selective mPFC units show at their preferred goal, while leaving their baseline rates intact.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: During choice runs the same goal-selective firing-rate elevation persisted despite terminal inhibition, so mPFC location coding at retrieval does not need the direct vHPC input.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Terminal inhibition did not change overall mPFC firing rates, either pooled or split into putative pyramidal cells and interneurons.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Decoding of the non-spatial task phase from mPFC firing survived sample-phase terminal inhibition, showing the deficit is specific to spatial cues rather than a general encoding failure.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A subset of mPFC units phase-locked to vHPC gamma, and phase-locking was strongest at lags where vHPC gamma preceded mPFC spiking, indicating vHPC leads mPFC in the gamma band.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Inhibiting the vHPC-mPFC terminals weakened gamma phase-locking, showing the long-range gamma synchrony depends on the direct anatomical projection.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In the theta band the directionality reversed - mPFC led vHPC - and theta synchrony was not affected by silencing the pathway.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Gamma phase-locking was stronger during sample runs than choice runs, and stronger on correct than incorrect sample runs, tying the synchrony to successful encoding.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Additionally, gamma phase-locking during sample runs distinguished correct from incorrect trials.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The mPFC showed no retrospective coding of the previously visited location, arguing against persistent mPFC firing as the storage mechanism during the delay.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
